meta.title: Engine
meta.description: The Ordo engine is written in Rust. Give it JSON, it runs your rules step by step and returns the result with the full path it took. Run it as a server or embed it in a program or a browser.

hero.title: Where the rules run
hero.subtitle: At the core of Ordo is a rule engine written in Rust. Give it JSON and it walks through your rules step by step, then returns the result and why each step went the way it did.

run.caption: The refund routing rules on four real messages. Jev answers from typesafe/jev-1.13; results match ordo trace.

points.title: Fast
points.desc: A rule with four branches runs in about 573 ns. One server handles about 60,000 HTTP requests a second.

points.title: Exact
points.desc: Money is computed as exact decimals, so 0.1 + 0.2 is 0.3. A missing field or a wrong type is an error, not a quiet trip down the wrong branch.

points.title: Runs anywhere
points.desc: Write and test rules with the CLI, serve them over HTTP or gRPC, or embed the engine in a Rust program or a browser. Same rule files.
